Class CloudRouterOperator.CloudRouterUpdater

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.fabric.model.json.creators.CloudRouterOperator.CloudRouterUpdater
Enclosing class:
CloudRouterOperator
public class CloudRouterOperator.CloudRouterUpdater extends Object
Fluent builder for updating an existing cloud router via RFC 6902 JSON Patch. Each typed setter records a replace operation; save() sends them as one PATCH with content-type application/json-patch+json and returns the refreshed model. 
cloudRouter.update().name("New-Name").save();

      public CloudRouterOperator.CloudRouterUpdater termLength(Integer termLength)
      Replaces the order term length (/order/termLength), e.g. to move the cloud router onto (or extend) a term commitment (Fabric releases R2025.6/R2026.1).
      Parameters:
      termLength - the new term length in months (for example 12, 24 or 36)
